dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, scalloped dark perimeters enclosing lighter grey/white elliptical interiors; most prominent along the mid-dorsal ridge. Gradient transitions are sharp at the outer edge, fading softly toward the interior center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of clustered high-intensity (white) pixel patches lacking internal gradients, primarily located along the lower lateral margin and the posterior flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A distinct triangular geometric relationship formed by the centroids of three large 'O' shaped annuli on the upper mid-back, with an adjacent linear alignment of four smaller 'C' shaped structures extending toward the tail.

other_distinctive_markers: Sharply defined, high-contrast vertical linear highlights corresponding to claw structures on the distal edge of the visible pectoral flipper.
